title: High intensity training during spaceflight: results from the NASA Sprint Study
extraction: Manual transcription of CON columns in Tables 1, 4, 5; numeric values unchanged. Ratios and daily rates are calculated by scripts/calibrate.py.
protocol: ARED resistance plus T2/CEVIS aerobic training, individualized, generally six days per week. The app uses a simplified 60/60-minute daily reference, not the study protocol.

outcomes.label: Leg lean mass (DXA)
outcomes.note: Leg lean mass change was not significant (time P=0.40). Lean tissue is a proxy, not isolated muscle mass or strength.

outcomes.label: Relative peak oxygen uptake
outcomes.note: VO2peak is measured; the legacy vo2max_pct JSON name is retained for compatibility.

limits: Group means are not individual records; their ratio is not the mean paired percentage change.
SE describes the mean, not an individual prediction interval. Paired covariance is unavailable.
Postflight days 7–14 are represented by day 11 for the fit; this is a chosen approximation.
Recovery and exercise equations are assumed. Back-calculating landing values does not measure landing outcomes.
No randomized no-exercise arm; minutes-to-benefit and no-exercise scenarios are illustrative.
Daily interpolation, long missions and Moon/Mars conditions are not established by this cohort.
Sprint and the 2023 multisystem study may overlap; they are not independent validation sets.
